title: Hitchhiker effect at Fugal's home: dog growling at 3 a.m.
summary: Brandon Fugal tells of Hitchhiker effect at Fugal's home: dog growling at 3 a.m., about c. 2024 at Fugal home, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: 3:00 a.m. or so, he would get up and start growling and barking at something that wasn't there, that was unseen,

plain: Brandon Fugal, a businessman who owns Skinwalker Ranch, a property famous for reports of strange events, talks about the "hitchhiker effect", the idea that something from the ranch can follow people home. He says that around 2024 his dog would get up at about 3 in the morning and growl and bark at something unseen in his house. If true, it would mean whatever is at the ranch does not stay there.
